info.title: ONESOURCE™ Tax Provision OData APIs
info.description: Tax Provision OData endpoints provide access to the OData and offer APIs to interact with data for various OneSource TaxProvision reports.

tags.name: On-Demand Data Refersh
tags.description: Provides data refresh capabilities for the ONESOURCE™ Tax Provision Data Query-Reporting tile and OData, allowing users to access the most current data without having to wait for scheduled updates.

tags.name: Componentdetail
tags.description: Retrives line-items details from the Tax Provision & Trial Balance reports for component-detail and State Tax Provision for component-detail-state.

tags.name: Deferredbalances
tags.description: Provides APIs to retrieve various types of deferred balances data including Pretax, Federal, State, FBOS, and Tax-Effected balances.

tags.name: Deferredworkpaper
tags.description: Retrieves temporary difference beginning and ending balances.

tags.name: Payable
tags.description: Retrieves taxes payable for units configured for datsets within an instance.

tags.name: Questionnaire
tags.description: Retrieves questions and answers associated with various questionnaires configured for datasets within a specific instance.

tags.name: Rollups
tags.description: Retrieves rollups defining how the data should be tiered.

tags.name: SignOffStatus
tags.description: Retrieves Sign-Off Status for user across three distinct views: Sign-Off, Unit and Status.

tags.name: StateProvision
tags.description: Retrieves state tax provision broken out by states.

tags.name: Subconsolidation
tags.description: Retrieves subconsolidations assigned within a specific instance.

tags.name: TaxProvision
tags.description: Retrieves provision calculations and includes supporting calculations.

get.description: Retrieves all component details based on the provided OData query options.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The max number of records.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: The number of records to skip.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: A function that must evaluate to true for a record to be returned.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Specifies a subset of properties to return. Use a comma separated list.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Determines what values are used to order a collection of records.

200.description: Returns the list of component details.

401.description: Unauthorized access due to invalid token or credentials.

500.description: Internal server error while fetching component details.

get.description: Returns the details of the most recently completed sync for the authenticated user's default instance, including its status, timestamp, triggered by user or automatic refresh, and when the next sync is scheduled.

200.description: Returns the last sync information including last sync time, current status, next scheduled sync, and submitted by user.

401.description: Unauthorized if the user is not authenticated or the token is invalid.

404.description: Not Found if the user does not have an OTP schema or no sync history is found.

500.description: Internal Server Error if an exception occurs while fetching the last sync details.

post.description: Triggers a sync for the default instance associated with the authenticated user. Use this endpoint to refresh data for the ONESOURCE Tax Provision Data Query — Reporting tile and OData, enabling access to the most current data without waiting for scheduled updates. .

200.description: Returns the sync details including last sync time and current status.

401.description: Unauthorized if the authentication token is invalid or missing.

500.description: Internal Server Error if an exception occurs while triggering the sync.

get.description: The sync history returns a list of all sync runs — both manual and scheduled — for the default instance, ordered from most recent to oldest. Each entry in the list represents a single sync run.
